description: Move a folder to a different space. Requires folder_id or folder_name + destination space_id or space_name.

allow_destructive_fallback.description: Allow move even if non-destructive methods fail. Default: false.

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

name: move_folder
